helpIntro: Florida State University uses a 4.00 scale with quarter-point plus/minus values: A=4.00, A-=3.75, B+=3.25, and F=0.00. Enter FSU semester hours and final grades to estimate your cumulative GPA.
helpNote: For standard undergraduate FSU cumulative GPA. Transfer and combined overall GPAs are separate; Law and Medicine use different grading systems. FSU discontinued grade forgiveness in Fall 2004, so the Repeat Impact replacement tool is unavailable.
helpExample: A 3-credit A earns 12.00 quality points and a 3-credit B+ earns 9.75. Together, 21.75 / 6 = 3.625.

gradeExplanations.A: A = 4.00 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.A-: A- = 3.75 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B+: B+ = 3.25 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B: B = 3.00 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B-: B- = 2.75 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C+: C+ = 2.25 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C: C = 2.00 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C-: C- = 1.75 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.D+: D+ = 1.25 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.D: D = 1.00 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.D-: D- = 0.75 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.F: F earns 0.00 quality points; its credit hours count in the GPA denominator.
gradeExplanations.P: Pass has no quality-point value and is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.U: Unsatisfactory under S/U grading is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.I: Incomplete is temporary and excluded until resolved.
gradeExplanations.NG: No grade received is temporary and excluded until resolved.
gradeExplanations.W: Withdrawn while passing is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.WD: Withdrawn with dean permission is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.EC: Examination credit is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.ED: Departmental examination credit is excluded from GPA.

specialTypes.name: Transfer or dual-enrollment work
specialTypes.note: Do not add transfer grades to the FSU cumulative GPA. FSU reports transfer and combined overall GPA separately.

specialTypes.name: College of Law course
specialTypes.note: Law uses a different grade-point map (including A+ 4.33); do not use the standard undergraduate scale.

specialTypes.name: College of Medicine course
specialTypes.note: Medicine uses HM/HP/PM and program-specific grading; review the medical record separately.

repeatPolicy.note: Enter each graded attempt as a separate completed course. Repeat Impact is disabled because FSU does not use ordinary grade replacement for current students.
